name: Image gallery
summary: A thumbnail grid with a lightbox view for browsing a set of images. Supports keyboard navigation and a visible counter.

anatomy.purpose: Responsive set of thumbnails; each is a button that opens the lightbox.
Full-viewport dialog showing the selected image with a close control.
"3 of 12" text so sighted and screen-reader users know position in the set.
Buttons to step through the set while the lightbox is open.

variants.name: Grid with lightbox
variants.use: Default; thumbnails open a large view.

contentLimits.alt: every image needs meaningful alt text or alt="" if decorative

variants.name: Thumbnail strip
variants.use: Single-row strip under a hero image, for product pages.

whenToUse: Showing multiple related images that belong together (project shots, product angles).
Users need to inspect images at full size.
whenNotToUse: A single hero image is enough: use an img with caption.
The images carry long-form narrative: use figures with captions in a document layout.

accessibility.role: dialog for the lightbox; buttons for thumbnails and controls
keyboard: Tab moves through thumbnails; Enter or Space opens the lightbox.
Left/Right arrows step between images in the lightbox.
Escape closes the lightbox and returns focus to the thumbnail that opened it.
accessibility.focus: Trap focus inside the lightbox while open; restore focus to the invoking thumbnail on close. Thumbnails show a 2px focus-visible ring with 3:1 contrast.
notes: Alt text is required for every meaningful image; never leave the lightbox image unlabeled.
The counter must be inside the dialog and exposed to screen readers via aria-live=polite or role=status.
Do not rely on swipe alone on touch devices; keep visible prev/next buttons.
